knownLimitations: Paid checkout, delivery, entitlement store, transactional email, portal and reconciliation are designed (docs/shop/FULFILMENT_ARCHITECTURE.md) and gated, not provisioned.
The availability endpoint is not configured; the form falls back to a pre-filled email until SHOP_AVAILABILITY_ENDPOINT points at a reviewed receiver.
Shop analytics are off until NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOP_ANALYTICS=v1; the measurement contract is documented in docs/shop/MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.md.
The Workflow Edition download bundle is specified by manifest and shared core; the packaged zip and signed delivery are gate work before checkout opens.
Hardware power, noise and expansion are marked not measured; only SKU facts present in the existing source records are shown.
Lighthouse figures come from a local production server, not the Vercel preview; re-measure on the preview URL before promotion.
